output_list.criticism: The mintToken function has an integer overflow that allows the owner to set the balance of an arbitrary user to any value. This vulnerability can be exploited by attackers who can manipulate the contract's state. The owner can throw, creating an arbitrary user to have access to the mintToken function.
The setPrices function does not check the caller's identity, allowing attackers to exploit it. The owner can throw, creating an arbitrary user to have access to the setPrices function.

The sell function has an integer overflow that allows the owner to set the balance of the contract to zero, sink all the funds, and gain nothing. This vulnerability can be exploited by attackers who can manipulate the contract's state.

The buy function has an integer overflow that allows the owner to set the balance of the contract to zero, sink all the funds, and gain nothing. This vulnerability can be exploited by attackers who can manipulate the contract's state.
